parameters.jsCode: const s=$json.stats; const bounced=s.hard_bounces+s.soft_bounces; const delivered=Math.max(0,s.sent-bounced); const rate=(a,b)=>b?+(100*a/b).toFixed(2):null; const metrics={delivery_rate:rate(delivered,s.sent),open_rate:rate(s.unique_opens,delivered),ctr:rate(s.unique_clicks,delivered),ctor:rate(s.unique_clicks,s.unique_opens),unsubscribe_rate:rate(s.unsubscribes,delivered),spam_rate:rate(s.spam,delivered)}; const gaps={open_rate:metrics.open_rate===null?null:+(metrics.open_rate-$json.targets.open_rate).toFixed(2),ctr:metrics.ctr===null?null:+(metrics.ctr-$json.targets.ctr).toFixed(2)}; return [{json:{...$json,metrics,gaps,funnel:{sent:s.sent,delivered,opened:s.unique_opens,clicked:s.unique_clicks},denominators:{delivery_rate:'sent',open_rate:'delivered',ctr:'delivered',ctor:'unique opens',unsubscribe_rate:'delivered',spam_rate:'delivered'}}}];

const k=$json.metrics,f=$json.funnel; const safe=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c])); const base=Math.max(1,f.sent); const bars=['sent','delivered','opened','clicked'].map(x=>`
${x}${f[x].toLocaleString()}
`).join(''); const cards=Object.entries(k).map(([a,b])=>`
${a.replaceAll('_',' ')}${b===null?'N/A':b+'%'}denominator: ${$json.denominators[a]}
`).join(''); const gap=(name)=>$json.gaps[name]===null?'N/A':`${$json.gaps[name]>0?'+':''}${$json.gaps[name]} pp`; return [{json:{html:`Newsletter dashboard

${safe($json.campaign.name)}

Campaign ${safe($json.campaign.id)} · status ${safe($json.campaign.status)} · refreshed ${safe($json.refreshed_at)}

${cards}

Delivery funnel

${bars}
Target gaps

Open rate: ${gap('open_rate')} · CTR: ${gap('ctr')}

Interpret opens directionally; privacy protections may distort them. Prefer downstream clicks and conversions for decisions.

`}}];

## Live MailerLite campaign analytics dashboard
Attach an n8n Header Auth credential containing `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and replace `TRAINING_CAMPAIGN_ID`. The workflow fetches the current campaign object, validates HTTP/schema state, calculates transparent metrics and returns a responsive HTML dashboard. Use the supplied CSV and sample HTML for a credential-free rehearsal.
